emily_z: Heads-up: new SI+HW marketplace submission for Orion Transport. Need quick ROE decision and who claims the lead.
raj_p: Quick context: Orion is NA, POC live, ~40k ARR. Not in active opp.
melissa_o: Proposed rule: POC <100k -> SI claims by default; partner must confirm within 72h or flips to Redwood-claim. Also require single SI rep + single HW rep for publish.
emily_z: Agree. Add requirement: KAM pre-notify for credit split before pipeline creation.
ops-bot: New listing form: https://redwood.app/listings/Orion-2026 
metadata: partner=BlueRidgeSI, hw=TerraNodes, sku=terra-orion-1.
raj_p: Action items: 1) Melissa to draft intro email template 2) Ops hold listing until claim 3) Olivia to pre-check credit split 4) Raj to create temp SFDC if no exact match.
melissa_o: Draft intro (short):
"Hi Orion team — BlueRidge (SI) will lead deployment on TerraNodes hardware. Redwood will provide inference platform and co-sell support. Please confirm primary procurement contact and pilot start date"
olivia_kam: I'll propose default 60/40 (SI/Redwood) for a POC this size, final after brief KAM review.
emily_z: Timeline: get claim + intro within 48h. If no SI claim, flip to Redwood and notify KAM. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
